name: Orkestra bridge
description: Telegram → orkestra: /run (/yap), /runs (/durum), /cancel (/iptal), /ide, plain-language requests through the orkestra_run tool, owner commands (passphrase), reply-to-answer, job notifications, autopilot owner mode (voice orders, attachments, queue, progress notes).

machineTasks.description: An owner order that names no project: ask which project (default) or hand it to the OpenClaw agent as a machine task.

autopilotAll.description: Autopilot owner mode: every request of the allowlisted owner becomes an owner job (no questions back), a busy project queues the request, and media sent with a request reaches the job as files.

progressMinutes.description: Minutes between progress notes on open Telegram runs (only when something changed); 0 = off.

attachmentRoots.description: Folders attachments may come from (default: the OpenClaw media folder and agent workspace).
